method_scope.semantic_role: select BIM/DA3 ratio samples for one global scale applied to every pixel
method_scope.purpose: estimate semantic global-scale value before pinning a semantic predictor

variant_definitions.scale_all: universal robust scale estimated from all valid BIM hits
variant_definitions.scale_core: one global robust scale estimated from semantic core pixels with any valid BIM hit
variant_definitions.scale_category_match: one global robust scale estimated only from image/BIM category-matched core pixels
variant_definitions.scale_category_match_bim_nonedge: category-matched global scale excluding rendered BIM depth edges
variant_definitions.scale_category_match_interior: category-matched global scale excluding both BIM edges and image semantic boundaries
variant_definitions.scale_category_balanced: one global scale equal to the median log scale across available matched interior classes

subset_definitions.all: all official valid z-depth pixels in [0.2, 5.0] m
